attributes.additional_details: cDonald’s UK, don’t bin Monopoly after 20+ years! From Becky Jones’ life-changing wins to our annual “sticker panic” at the drive-thru, this game is British legacy. A free McFlurry or fruit bag won’t replace the thrill of hunting Mayfair or winning a Mini. Bring back Monopoly in 2026, keep the stickers, the instant wins, and the dream. Don’t make us petition in Big Mac boxes. #BringBackMonopoly #McDonaldsUK
attributes.background: McDonald’s can’t discontinue McDonalds it’s a legacy!! “I’ve won mcflerry or fruit bag! I wonder what we’re gonna choose there? Probably the fruit bag” Becky jones McDonald’s monopoly 2022
